pr_title: kvserver: fix a span-use-after-Finish in closedts nudging
pr_body:
The process of "nudging" a replica to close a timestamp was spawning an
async task without waiting for it to finish. The task was capturing the
caller's ctx, and using its span. That span might Finish()
asynchronously, leading to use-after-Finish().
This patch fixes the bug by creating a dedicated span for the task.

Fixes #74012

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/74099)
